title: Monitoring page in the newsroom Administration
description:
Editors and admins can see the automated research pipeline (HN collector and Cyclotron router) in the newsroom, read-only.

```gherkin
Feature: Monitoring page
  Scenario: An editor sees what the pipeline did for their publication
    Given the collector and router have recorded runs, discoveries and routing decisions
    When an editor opens Administration, Monitoring
    Then they see the feeds watched, recent runs, the collected queue with routing states, per-item relevance for their publication with a link to the References entry, and usage against the ceilings
  Scenario: A non-editor is refused
    When a reader asks for the monitoring overview
    Then the request is refused and no data is returned
  Scenario: Nothing collected yet
    Given the table has no discoveries
    Then the page says so plainly and shows the router mode
```

Design: AppSync query monitoringOverview (editor/admin) -> Python Lambda with a read-only IAM grant (GetItem, Query) on the monitoring table and its routing index; table found via an SSM parameter written by the papyrus-monitoring stack; own publication matched by AppSync endpoint; whole pipeline admin-only.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Shipped. PRs #422 (page), #428 (bundling fix for a dependency-free function), #432 (guard fix). Released 5.2.0 then 5.4.0 (5.3.0 and 5.2.0 backend builds failed on the empty pip requirement list; fixed in 5.4.0). Monitoring stack updated by change set (router with confidence, SSM table-name parameter); ceilings seeded. Rolled out: Threat-Intelligence job 50, Pilobol.us job 50, p.apyr.us job 55, Anth.us job 16 all SUCCEED; TI page 200 and the function answered a synthetic admin event. Distinctive pins exact versions and still needs the 5.4.0 bump.
